description_en: Modifies an Express Connect Quality of Service (QoS) policy. You can also use this operation to associate dedicated Express Connect circuits with the policy
description_zh: 调用ModifyExpressConnectTrafficQos接口修改高速通道QoS策略，也可通过本接口关联独享物理专线
kebab_example: aliyun vpc modify-express-connect-traffic-qos --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --qos-id qos-2giu0a6vd5x0mv0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyExpressConnectTrafficQos

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the QoS policy.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html operation to query the region ID
parameters.help_zh:
QoS策略所在的地域ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html接口获取地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the RequestId of the API request as the ClientToken. The RequestId may be different for each API request
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId不一样
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
The name of the QoS policy.

The name must be 0 to 128 characters in length and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`
parameters.help_zh:
QoS策略的名称。

长度为0～128个字符，不能以`http://`或`https://`开头
parameters.name: qos_name

parameters.help_en:
The description of the QoS policy.

The description must be 0 to 256 characters in length and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`
parameters.help_zh:
QoS策略的描述信息。

长度为0～256个字符，不能以`http://`或`https://`开头
parameters.name: qos_description

parameters.help_en: The ID of the QoS policy
parameters.name: qos_id

fields.help_en: The instance ID of the instance to associate
fields.name: instance_id

fields.help_en: The type of the instance to associate. Valid values: PHYSICALCONNECTION: Express Connect circuit
fields.help_zh: 需要关联实例的类型。取值：PHYSICALCONNECTION物理专线
fields.name: instance_type

parameters.help_en: The list of instances to add in this update. You do not need to specify this parameter if no instances need to be added
parameters.help_zh: 本次更新需要添加的实例列表，如果没有需要添加的实例可以不用传递此参数
parameters.name: add_instance_list

fields.help_en: The instance ID of the associated instance
fields.name: instance_id

fields.help_en: The type of the associated instance. Valid values: PHYSICALCONNECTION: Express Connect circuit
fields.help_zh: 关联实例的类型。取值：PHYSICALCONNECTION物理专线
fields.name: instance_type

parameters.help_en: The list of instances to remove in this update. You do not need to specify this parameter if no instances need to be removed
parameters.help_zh: 本次更新需要移除的实例列表，如果没有需要移除的实例可以不用传递此参数
parameters.name: remove_instance_list
